flight-cancellations.label: Flight Cancellations
flight-cancellations.description: Cancels a share of departing flights at boarding, so the Aircraft Turnaround flow shows a flight.cancelled error branch + drop-off at the Boarding step.

passenger-offloads.label: Passenger Offloads
passenger-offloads.description: Offloads a share of passengers at security, so the Passenger Journey flow shows a passenger.offloaded error branch + drop-off at the Security step.
